recipeSummary.formulaContract: Quantity is per one ordinary engram craft. Multiply by each counted physical part; sum identical ingredient names. This is direct inventory ingredient cost, not recursive raw-resource expansion. Machines exclude operating fuel, ammunition and crafted contents. Unknown recipe entries must be omitted from totals and visibly counted as unknown; do not silently use zero.
recipeSummary.doorframeCorrection: ASA ordinary doorway is a placement variant of Stone Wall, Doorways & Windowframe: 40 Stone, 20 Wood, 15 Thatch. ASE separate Stone Doorframe 30/16/12 is not the recipe for this ASA combined item.

facts.finding: Wildcard ASA DevKit is a customized Unreal Engine 5 editor, listed for Windows, and includes full-game content. Its store page lists 1.5 TB SSD minimum and 4 TB SSD recommended; this is an installation dependency, not evidence that any particular structure was exported.
Official installation guide uses Epic Games Launcher, recommends SSD and 1.2–1.5 TB available space, and distinguishes stable/LKG and beta editors.

Generic Unreal asset workflow: select a supported asset in Content Browser, right-click Asset Actions > Export; static meshes can expose FBX or OBJ export. Epic states not every asset can be exported. These generic editor instructions have not been tested against ASA structure blueprints in this task.

Wildcard documents an armor-specific Blender .blend tool and FBX import/export workflow. It does not provide a Blender pack containing all structure or machine meshes, and is not evidence of a completed structure export.

candidateWorkflow: On an available Windows ASA DevKit installation, locate each actual item structure blueprint and its rendered mesh components; record original package paths, variants, transforms and units. Do not treat inventory icons as models.

Attempt a small verified ordinary Stone Foundation/static-mesh export through the editor-supported Export action. Export dependent textures separately and record material slots; export moving skeletal components/animations only where the tool actually supports them.

Import the verified interchange assets into Blender, check scale/orientation/materials and geometry against the current game, then place each exact asset instance using the planner layout. Preserve a manifest mapping item ID to original package and imported object.

Bake/simplify for iPad while preserving recognizable appearance, physical bounds and collision. An authored schematic proxy must be labeled as an approximate proxy until actual game assets replace it.
